source_text: In tribulatione clamant ad Dominum. Tribulatio convertit. Exaudit gemitus paenitentium.
pass_a_gloss: In tribulation they-cry unto Lord. Tribulation converts. He-hears groans of-penitents.
pass_b_english: In tribulation they cry to the Lord. Tribulation converts. He hears penitents’ groans.
notes: True OET; no copyrighted Judges FOTC.
